title: Messages to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, and Thyatira

questions.question: To the angel of the church in Ephesus write... "I know your works, your toil and your patient endurance, and how you cannot bear with those who are ____,"
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:1-2 (ESV): "To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: ...'I know your works, your toil and your patient endurance, and how you cannot bear with those who are evil,'"

questions.question: But I have this against you (Ephesus), that you have abandoned the ____ you had at first.
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:4 (ESV): "But I have this against you, that you have abandoned the love you had at first."

questions.question: To the one who conquers I will grant to eat of the ____, which is in the paradise of God.
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:7 (ESV): "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who conquers I will grant to eat of the tree of life, which is in the paradise of God."

questions.question: And to the angel of the church in Smyrna write... "I know your tribulation and your ____ (but you are rich) and the slander of those who say that they are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan."
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:8-9 (ESV): "'I know your tribulation and your poverty (but you are rich) and the slander of those who say that they are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.'"

questions.question: Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested, and for ____ days you will have tribulation.
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:10 (ESV): "Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested, and for ten days you will have tribulation."

questions.question: Be faithful unto death, and I will give you the crown of ____.
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:10 (ESV): "...Be faithful unto death, and I will give you the crown of life."

questions.question: The one who conquers will not be hurt by the second ____.
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:11 (ESV): "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who conquers will not be hurt by the second death."

questions.question: And to the angel of the church in Pergamum write... "I know where you dwell, where Satan's ____ is."
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:12-13 (ESV): "...'I know where you dwell, where Satan's throne is. Yet you hold fast my name, and you did not deny my faith even in the days of Antipas my faithful witness, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.'"

questions.question: But I have a few things against you (Pergamum): you have some there who hold the teaching of ____, who taught Balak to put a stumbling block before the sons of Israel,
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:14 (ESV): "But I have a few things against you: you have some there who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to put a stumbling block before the sons of Israel, so that they might eat food sacrificed to idols and practice sexual immorality."

questions.question: So also you have some who hold the teaching of the ____.
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:15 (ESV): "So also you have some who hold the teaching of the Nicolaitans."

questions.question: To the one who conquers I will give some of the hidden ____, and I will give him a white stone, with a new name written on the stone...
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:17 (ESV): "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who conquers I will give some of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, with a new name written on the stone that no one knows except the one who receives it."

questions.question: And to the angel of the church in Thyatira write... "I know your works, your love and faith and service and patient endurance, and that your ____ works exceed the first."
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:18-19 (ESV): "...'I know your works, your love and faith and service and patient endurance, and that your latter works exceed the first.'"

questions.question: But I have this against you (Thyatira), that you tolerate that woman ____, who calls herself a prophetess and is teaching and seducing my servants...
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:20 (ESV): "But I have this against you, that you tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess and is teaching and seducing my servants to practice sexual immorality and to eat food sacrificed to idols."

questions.question: And all the churches will know that I am he who searches ____ and ____, and I will give to each of you according to your works.
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:23 (ESV): "and I will strike her children dead. And all the churches will know that I am he who searches mind and heart, and I will give to each of you according to your works."

questions.question: Only hold fast what you have until I ____.
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:25 (ESV): "Only hold fast what you have until I come."

key_verse_text: Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested, and for ten days you will have tribulation. Be faithful unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.
